<img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/usectionmarkaligner.png" alt="" width="48" height="48" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1rem;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px" />

{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → `uSectionMarkAligner` (also on the Drawing ribbon tab, *Section Marks*)
{{% /callout %}}

Lines up the ends of section marks you have already selected in the active drawing, renames them, and can number them in reading order. The dialog stays open, so another group is just select, then click again.

**How to use:**

1.  Select one or more section marks with Tekla's own selection tool (box, Ctrl+click).
2.  Click **Align left end** or **Align right end**, then pick a point in the drawing. The chosen end of each selected section line moves along the line to line up with the picked point. <kbd>Esc</kbd> cancels.
3.  Use the *Section name* box with **+** and **\-** to rename the selected marks, or type a name and press Enter.

| Option | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Align left / right end** | Left and right are Tekla's own names for the two ends of the mark, not screen directions. Only horizontal and vertical section lines are supported; any other mark is skipped and counted in the status line. Marks in different views are each measured in their own view. |
| **Section name, + and -** | Counts the last run of digits or letters in the name up or down by one (A to B, 9 to 10, A1 to A2, 008 to 009). Words such as Section cannot be counted; nothing is renamed then. Enter in the box gives the marks exactly the typed text. |
| **Follow selection** | On (default): the box shows the name of the selected mark. Off: the box holds the next name to hand out, and + / - name the marks with it and then count the box. |
| **Resequence on align** | Off by default. On: after every Align the selected marks are also numbered in reading order on the sheet (top row first, left to right inside a row), starting from the name in the box and counting from it. Marks within 1 mm of height of the first mark of a row are one row, measured from the end you just aligned, so marks of different line lengths still line up. It runs on the whole selection, only when two or more marks are selected; if the name cannot be counted far enough nothing is renamed and the status line says so. |

The status line under the buttons reports what was done and what was skipped. The Help link at the top opens this guide.

**How counting works:** only the last run of digits or letters in the name is counted; everything before it stays as typed. Going up:

-   1, 2, 3 ... 9, 10 (zero-padded names keep their width: 008, 009, 010)
-   A, B, C ... Z, AA, AB ... (lower case works the same: a, b, c)
-   A1, A2, A3 ... A9, A10
-   1A, 1B, 1C ... 1Z, 1AA
-   A-A, A-B, A-C ... and SEC 3, SEC 4

Going down is the exact reverse and stops at the first value (A, or 0); numbers never go negative. Not counters: words and mixed case such as Section, letter runs longer than three (ABCD), and names that do not end in a letter or digit (A-). With Follow selection on, + and - refuse these and rename nothing; with it off, the name is still given to the marks and the box stays as typed.

With Follow selection on and several marks selected, the box shows their name only when they all have the same one; otherwise, and when nothing is selected, the box is left as it is. With Follow selection off, for example: type 1, select a mark, click +; the mark is named 1 and the box shows 2.
